sql: SELECT AVG(CAST(substr(res.fastestLapTime, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(substr(res.fastestLapTime, 4) AS REAL)) AS average_fastest_lap_seconds FROM results AS res JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND res.fastestLapTime GLOB '[0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9].[0-9][0-9][0-9]'
